form.official-title: To prohibit the Securities and Exchange Commission from requiring that personally identifiable information be collected under consolidated audit trail reporting requirements, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Protecting Investors’ Personally Identifiable Information Act.

section.header: Personally identifiable information excluded from consolidated audit trail reporting requirements

subsection.text: The Securities and Exchange Commission may not require a national securities exchange, a national securities association, or a member of such an exchange or association to provide personally identifiable information with respect to a market participant to meet the requirements relating to an order or a reportable event under section 242.613(c)(7) of title 17, Code of Federal Regulations.

In this section, the term personally identifiable information means an individual’s name, address, date of birth, Social Security number, taxpayer-identification number, financial account number, driver’s license number, alien registration number, telephone number, email address, Internet Protocol address, or biometric data.
